Cape Town · Western Cape, South Africa

Cape Town

Cape Town is one of the continent’s best urban anchors, particularly for travelers who want city life, food, and a softer landing before or after safari.

Photos: Romaine (CC0 1.0). Displayed images may be resized or cropped. Photo details.

What it is

Cape Town is a nature-wrapped city centered on Table Mountain and the Cape Peninsula.

What draws people here

  • Table Mountain views and cableway
  • Cape Peninsula route and Boulders penguins
  • Robben Island and District Six

How to get there

Fly into Cape Town International Airport and base in the city bowl, Atlantic Seaboard, or Winelands edge.

Best time

October to April is ideal for city, coast, and wine country combinations.

Planning notes

Weather can close the cableway or ferries with little notice; use established transport after dark.
